upgrade_card_craftybot_lesson:
Reducing hours of brain-melting study for your Crafty-Bot, the Crafty-Bot Lesson Voucher contains special crib-note code facilitating the instant learning of one (1) skill.
Category: Cards and tickets
upgrade_card_instant_resurrection:
Escape from the underworld: instantly, with energy tank fully replenished and the soles of your feet barely scorched.
Category: Cards and tickets
How to get it: Comes with the Imagination upgrade card “Get Out of Hell Free Card”.
What it is for: Use it while you are dead to come back to life at once with a full tank of energy and mood.
upgrade_card_reshuffle:
If you don't like the hand fate has dealt you, fight for a new one. And so it is here, though for "fight" read "swap this card for", for "hand" read "Upgrade Cards". And apparently for "that first…
Category: Cards and tickets
How to get it: Comes with the Imagination upgrade card “Reshuffle”.
What it is for: Use it to reshuffle the Upgrade Cards in your hand for free.
What it is for: It also shows as a "Use a Reshuffle Card" button in the Upgrades panel.
urfu:

An ingredient in 3 recipes: Super Veggie Kebabs, Maburger Royale, Pad Tii
vegmageddon:

Category: Food
How to get it: Vegmageddon, Corn, Parsnip, Carrot, Broccoli, with a Famous Pugilist Grill, needs Grilling I, each
What it is for: Eat it for 90 energy.
An ingredient in 4 recipes: Super Veggie Kebabs, Awesome Stew, Precious Potato Salad, Potian's Feast
visiting_stone:
A confederate in the grand System of Stones and Rocks whose aim in life is to redistribute the Glitch here and there and make sure each has a chance to see each.
Visiting Stones can typically be found in "dead-end locations" of most regions.
Category: Street objects
What it is for: Visit to be sent to a neighbour's home street, and Go back from there when you are done. Flip turns it around.
What it is for: In multiplayer it sends you to a random real player's home.
What it is for: From level, with a home and a Butler, Get visitors opts you in to random visitors (Stop random visitors opts out).
waffles:
Fluffy waffles with extra-deep waffle-holes.
Category: Food
How to get it: Waffles, Honey, Swing Batter, Desssert Rub, Waffle, with a Famous Pugilist Grill, needs Grilling I, each, A reward for the quest “Greedy Street Spirit Story”.
What it is for: Eat it for 185 energy.
What it is for: 50 street projects ask for it.
wall_button:
Category: Street objects
What it is for: A red Wall Button you press in puzzle rooms: in An Old Fashioned B&E it turns the shaft tile beside it, in Le Misérable it resets a light panel.
What it is for: In the Hall of Rejected Concepts each of the 14 exhibits has one: press it to read that exhibit's caption.
wall_segment:
On its own, it would just fall over. But among a house and other Wall Segments, it becomes the building block of home expansions. Useful for widening and adding floors to houses.
The recipe for this will become available after you learn Engineering I and Furnituremaking II.
Category: Other
How to get it: Wall Segment, Beam, Wood Post, Board, Barnacle Talc, with a Construction Tool, needs Engineering, needs Furnituremaking II, each
What it is for: Use one in your house to make it a wall segment wider (up to 20). On a house with more floors each new segment takes one per floor, plus Urth Blocks and Girders.
What it is for: Building your home street Tower takes, and each extra Tower floor takes .
wall_switch:
Category: Street objects
What it is for: In Color Unblocking, press a coloured switch to turn that colour's blocks on or off and clear your way to the exit.
water_cooler:
Water dispensing devices do not get more generic than this. It is as plain as could be. Were it possible for water to be beige, beige this water would be.
Category: Street objects
What it is for: Get water from it in a Bureaucratic Hall for a Cup of Water (costs 2 energy). Drinking the cup is how Being Watched starts.
watering_can:
A stainless-steel 5-gallon watering can. It can be used to water plants, trees, and crops.
You can use this, but it's much better to learn Light Green Thumb I first.
This can be made with a Tinkertool or purchased from a Gardening Goods Vendor, a Tool Vendor or a Gardening Tools Vendor.
The recipe for this will become available after you learn Tinkering IV.
Category: Tools
How to get it: Gardening Goods Vendor, Tool Vendor, Gardening Tools Vendor, Watering Can, Tin Ingot, with a Tinkertool, needs Tinkering IV, each, A reward for the quest “Meet the Merchants”.
What it is for: 407 street projects need work done with it.
What it is for: Water Paper Trees., Water garden plots.

wine_of_the_dead:
A forbidding decanter filled with wine of the dead, made from grapes crushed in Purgatory. This Hade-licious drink will revive even the most pooped of hellions... but will kill all who drink it…
Wine of the Dead can be obtained in Hell Bar, for a Diabolical Drink Ticket.
Category: Drinks
How to get it: Trade a Diabolical Drink Ticket to Hell's Bartender in the Hell Bar, Panka Surazu.
What it is for: Drink it while dead in Hell to stop being Pooped (and stay safe from it). Drink it while alive and you die and go to Hell.
What it is for: Pour it on a cultivated item on your home street to wear it out, or on a home project in progress to cancel it.
What it is for: Drinking one is part of the Beelzebooze quest.
wood_post:
If you squint and look hard, you can almost see the joins where the Planks were put together to make Boards, and the Boards tirelessly hewn into a Post. But in its glorious finished form, you can't…
This can be made with a Woodworker.
You need to learn Woodworking to use a Woodworker.
Category: Resources
How to get it: Wood Post, Board, with a Woodworker, needs Woodworking, no energy, each, plus a batch
An ingredient in 15 recipes: Chair, Armchair, Bed, Sofa, Door, Wall Segment, Cabinet, Loveseat, Table, Coffee Table, Bench, Beam, Small Cabinet, Spindle, Ace of Spades
wood_tree:
While all trees are woody, the Wood Tree is woodier than most. Tending to your wood is a rewarding solitary pursuit, but gathering friends to engorge your wood before all wielding your choppers…
The more mature the Wood Tree, the more Planks can be harvested from it!
Wood Tree grows quicker if petted by many people!
You can grow this by planting a Wood Tree Bean in a Patch.
Harvesting this will yield Planks.
Category: Resources
What it is for: Harvest it with a Hatchet or Class Axe for 25 to 80 Planks, more the bigger it is, once a game day. Harvesting slowly shrinks it, and harvesting the smallest one fells it.
What it is for: Pet it and water it (with a Watering Can or Irrigator 9000) for mood and iMG.
What it is for: In the Enchanted Forests: harvest it with a Hatchet or Class Axe for 10 to 60 Planks, more the bigger it is, once a game day. Pet it and water it (with a Watering Can) to help it grow. Harvested all…
woodworker:
How much wood would a Woodworker work if a Woodworker could work wood, you say? Glad you asked. It's four. Four Planks make a Board, four Boards a Post, four posts make a Beam. So how much wood would…
You need the skill Woodworking to use this.
You'll need a Machine Stand, Woodworker Fuser, Woodworker Chassis and Machine Engine to assemble a Woodworker.
Category: Machines
How to get it: Assembled from Machine Stand, Woodworker Fuser, Woodworker Chassis and Machine Engine.
The tool for 3 recipes: Board, Wood Post, Beam
woodworker_chassis:
One of the four essential parts of the Woodworker, the chassis is essential in helping every upstanding wannabe woodworker gird their woodworkerly loin-parts and whittle their brown stuff into…
You can use this to assemble a Woodworker.
Category: Machines
How to get it: Hardware Vendor, Tool Vendor
What it is for: A part for Woodworker.
woodworker_fuser:
You can use this to assemble a Woodworker.
In Tiny Speck’s game: The business end of the hardworking woodworking Woodworker, this is the bit that actually works the wood. Responsible for fusing planks into boards, boards into posts, posts into beams and dreams into reality (as long as you dream of wood).
Category: Machines
How to get it: Hardware Vendor, Tool Vendor
What it is for: A part for Woodworker.
yellow_crumb_flower:
Like having a tiny garden full of sunshine. How clever!
You can grow this by planting Yellow Crumb Flower Seeds in a Herb Garden.
In Tiny Speck’s game: Munching on this will give you the Crumb of Knowledge buff (double learning speed for ).
Buffs: Crumb of Knowledge: Suddenly you feel super focused. Doubles learning speed for
Category: Food
How to get it: Grown in a garden plot from Yellow Crumb Flower Seed.
How to get it: Handed to you when you take the quest “Shucks To Be You”.
What it is for: Its shuck verb turns it into Yellow Crumb Flower Seed.
What it is for: Munch it: The Yellow Crumb Flower can help you focus..
An ingredient in one recipe: Essence of Yellow Crumb
your_papers:
Here is a full yet incomplete set of all the papers a person might require in order that they may prove, justify or otherwise provide evidence that their papers are in order.
